quote.title: AVA Residences interiors by Elie Saab Maison
quote.mainText: AVA HOLDING CREATES MORE THAN BUILDINGS — IT CREATES THE FOUNDATION FOR A COMFORTABLE, MEANINGFUL, AND FORWARD-LOOKING FUTURE.
quote.caption1: Founded in 2017, AVA Holding is one of Armenia's most promising real estate development and construction companies. Its core focus is the creation of multifunctional residential buildings that meet the evolving needs of modern life. Today, one of Armenia's most significant challenges — and opportunities — is to stand among the world's leading innovators. Achieving that visibility would firmly place our country on the global stage.
quote.caption2: At the same time, in a world advancing at high speed, we believe it is vital not to lose sight of what matters most: people, safety, and the feeling of home. That's why AVA Holding aims to build more than just modern buildings — it creates spaces where people feel warmth, comfort, and belonging. Each project blends forward-thinking architecture with everyday practicality, driven by a deep respect for both place and person, chasing the main manifesto — LIVING PERFECTED.

founderText.name: EDUARD GHAZARYAN
founderText.role: FOUNDER OF AVA HOLDING AND DEVELOPER OF AVA RESIDENCES INTERIORS BY ELIE SAAB
founderText.paragraph1: At AVA Holding, our vision is built on a commitment to shaping exceptional living spaces and introducing a new standard of residential living to Armenia. Grounded in years of diverse entrepreneurial experience across multiple industries, the holding was established to bring world-class property development and strategic investment projects to life.
founderText.paragraph3: Today, AVA Holding manages a dynamic portfolio spanning premium residential communities, commercial real estate, modern business centers, and logistics facilities. Our cornerstone development, AVA Residences, exemplifies this mission — a luxury residential complex in Yerevan designed in collaboration
founderText.paragraph2: with Elie Saab Maison to set a new standard of living through uncompromising elegance, contemporary architecture, and refined interiors.
founderText.paragraph4: Our purpose goes beyond building structures. We aim to elevate urban development by combining international standards of craftsmanship and design with meticulous attention to detail. Every project undertaken by AVA Holding reflects a dedication to creating spaces that empower people to experience a higher, international standard of living — combining quality, aesthetic value, and enduring prestige in Armenia.

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.content: Welcome to AVA. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy will inform you about how we look after your personal data when you visit our website and tell you about your privacy rights.

section2.title: 2. Information We Collect
section2.intro: We may collect, use, store and transfer different kinds of personal data about you:
section2.identityDataDesc: includes first name, last name, username or similar identifier.
section2.contactDataDesc: includes email address and telephone numbers.
section2.technicalDataDesc: includes internet protocol (IP) address, browser type and version, time zone setting and location, browser plug-in types and versions, operating system and platform.
section2.usageDataDesc: includes information about how you use our website and services.

section3.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
section3.intro: We will only use your personal data when the law allows us to. Most commonly, we will use your personal data in the following circumstances:
section3.item1: To provide and maintain our services
section3.item2: To notify you about changes to our services
section3.item4: To gather analysis or valuable information to improve our services
section3.item5: To monitor the usage of our services
section3.item6: To detect, prevent and address technical issues

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.content: We have put in place appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered or disclosed. We limit access to your personal data to those employees, agents, contractors and other third parties who have a business need to know.

section5.title: 5. Data Retention
section5.content: We will only retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes we collected it for, including for the purposes of satisfying any legal, accounting, or reporting requirements.

section6.title: 6. Your Legal Rights
section6.intro: Under certain circumstances, you have rights under data protection laws in relation to your personal data, including the right to:
section6.item1: Request access to your personal data
section6.item2: Request correction of your personal data
section6.item3: Request erasure of your personal data
section6.item4: Object to processing of your personal data
section6.item5: Request restriction of processing your personal data
section6.item6: Request transfer of your personal data

section7.title: 7. Cookies
section7.content: Our website uses cookies to distinguish you from other users of our website. This helps us to provide you with a good experience when you browse our website and also allows us to improve our site.

section8.title: 8. Third-Party Links
section8.content: This website may include links to third-party websites, plug-ins and applications. Clicking on those links or enabling those connections may allow third parties to collect or share data about you. We do not control these third-party websites and are not responsible for their privacy statements.

section9.title: 9. Contact Us
section9.content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or our privacy practices, please contact us:
